harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker to run as a systemd service named inventory-worker on node1, under a dedicated system account inventorysvc. Verified it runs unprivileged, is enabled at boot, and survives a full node restart with a changed boot_id.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker and confirmed it is an executable long-running sh script
Created dedicated system account inventorysvc (no login shell, no home dir)
Wrote /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service with User=inventorysvc, Group=inventorysvc, ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker, Restart=on-failure, WantedBy=multi-user.target
Ran systemctl daemon-reload, enabled --now inventory-worker, and verified active/running state and process owner
Captured baseline boot_id, scheduled and acknowledged a systemd reboot, polled until node1 reconnected
Verified boot_id changed (901ef286... -> 77f25bca...) confirming a genuine restart
Verified inventory-worker auto-started post-restart, still running as inventorysvc, and inventorysvc account persisted

evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker runs as managed service inventory-worker under dedicated inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: Confirmed binary present, created inventorysvc system user, wrote and enabled inventory-worker.service, verified it is active/running with User=inventorysvc and processes owned by inventorysvc
Captured boot_id 901ef286-c79c-44c0-ad2c-cfde1f6daa7a as baseline boot identity while service was already verified healthy

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and disruption evidence
evidence.summary: Reboot scheduled via systemd-run with ack returned before disconnect; subsequent command timed out, proving the node was mid-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 77f25bca-e384-4bcc-a98c-2c8c78e0ab8c, a new value distinct from the baseline, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required service
evidence.summary: Post-restart check shows inventory-worker.service active/running (new PID 652) as inventorysvc, and inventorysvc account still present, confirming full recovery
